workload: the measure.rs graph: two I64 inputs, add, mul, mul, sub, eq; two outputs; rows cycle the seven i64 boundary values

instruments.time: wall-clock nanoseconds, release build, one thread; cold costs as the first call in the process and the median of five fresh calls; per-size costs as the median of five
instruments.bytes: declared from sizes, not measured: retained_bytes and scratch_bytes of the compiled graph; staged inputs, per-row reports, the outputs each report owns, and the copied outputs as element counts times size_of
instruments.memory: resident-set growth across the first run at each size, from /proc/self/statm with a 4096-byte page

unavailable: allocation counts: the workspace forbids unsafe_code, so no counting global allocator can exist in any target
extraction: the workload is an authored ngraph-ir/0 graph, so no extraction cost exists for it
non_claims: Reporting only: no timing threshold is a correctness claim.
One host and one run; the numbers bound nothing on other hardware.
